en: The postcard shows a large, early 20th-century building with Art Nouveau architectural features, including large windows and geometric shapes. The scene captures the building in a semi-landscaped area with an unpaved path, rocks, and a bare tree in the foreground. At the top right corner, the word 'Wanemuine' is printed. There is a faint text on the right edge reading 'K. Stuhl, Leipzig.'
